name: System X
goal: End-to-end figurative glyph authoring, including ideation, decomposition, categorical and numerical encoding, assembly, placement, and export.
description: the system helps users create figurative glyph-based visualizations from tabular data. It combines language and image generation, interactive segmentation, attribute encoding, and rule-based placement, allowing users to progressively refine the resulting visualization. Actors: model_1 = language model; model_2 = image generation model; model_3 = image segmentation model; model_4 = vision-language model; model_5 = ControlNet-conditioned diffusion model; tool_1 = data processing and prompt construction utilities; tool_2 = image edge detection algorithm; tool_3 = image processing libraries; tool_4 = rule-based visualization placement recommender.

processes.name: Recommend figurative concepts
processes.description: When the user uploads a CSV dataset, the system identifies categorical and numerical attributes and describes them to model_1, which suggests semantically related keywords. The system displays these keywords in a word cloud and uses model_2 to generate three candidate images for each suggested concept.
processes.rawExpression:
(dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_1 extract]
-> (attributes_1: artifact record)
-> [tool_1 translate]
-> (dataset_description_1: artifact language)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (keyword_response_1: artifact language)
-> [tool_1 extract]
-> (keywords_1: artifact language)*
-> [tool_1 translate]
-> (keywords_1: artifact language)* + (word_cloud_1: artifact visual)
-> [tool_1 compose]
-> (image_prompts_1: instruction language)*
-> [model_2 generate]~
-> (candidate_images_1: artifact visual)*

processes.name: Refine figurative image candidates
processes.description: After seeing the recommended concepts and images, the user can choose a keyword or enter a custom description. model_2 generates new image candidates from the prompt, and the user can refresh the results or revise the description repeatedly until a suitable figurative concept is found.
processes.rawExpression:
(candidate_images_1: artifact visual)* + (keywords_1: artifact language)* + (word_cloud_1: artifact visual)
-> [human specify]
-> (concept_prompt_1: instruction language)
-> [tool_1 compose]
-> (image_prompt_2: instruction language)
-> [model_2 generate]~
-> (candidate_images_2: artifact visual)*
-> [human modify]
-> (concept_prompt_1: instruction language)

processes.name: Select figurative prototype
processes.description: Once the generated candidates contain a suitable figurative design, the user selects one image as the prototype for segmentation and attribute mapping.

processes.name: Segment and map glyph components
processes.description: After selecting a figurative image, the user draws bounding boxes around components to be used for data encoding. The model_3 generates masks for these regions, which the user can refine before assigning each component to a categorical attribute, a numerical attribute, or both.
processes.rawExpression:
(glyph_image_1: artifact visual) + (attributes_1: artifact record)
-> [human select]
-> (glyph_image_1: artifact visual) + (regions_1: selection spatial)*
-> [model_3 extract]
-> (glyph_image_1: artifact visual) + (masks_1: artifact spatial)*
-> [human modify]
-> (glyph_image_1: artifact visual) + (masks_2: artifact spatial)*
-> [human assign]
-> (glyph_image_1: artifact visual) + (masks_2: artifact spatial)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)*

processes.name: Generate and refine categorical encodings
processes.description: After the user submits the segmented components and attribute mappings, tool_2 extracts fragment boundaries and model_4 describes the visual objects. A ControlNet-conditioned diffusion model generates color- and texture-based variants for categorical values, which the user can regenerate or customize through prompts until the encodings match their design intentions.
processes.rawExpression:
(glyph_image_1: artifact visual) + (masks_2: artifact spatial)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_2 extract]
-> (fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (fragment_edges_1: artifact spatial)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [model_4 generate]~
-> (fragment_descriptions_1: artifact language)* + (fragment_edges_1: artifact spatial)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_1 compose]
-> (encoding_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (fragment_edges_1: artifact spatial)*
-> [model_5 generate]~
-> (categorical_fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (encoding_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (fragment_edges_1: artifact spatial)*
-> [human modify]
-> (encoding_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (fragment_edges_1: artifact spatial)*

processes.name: Encode numerical attributes and assemble glyphs
processes.description: After categorical encoding, the user chooses how numerical attributes affect glyph components through size scaling or horizontal, vertical, or path-based duplication. The user can also adjust fragment spacing and layer order, preview the assembled glyphs, and repeatedly refine these settings until the glyph structures are satisfactory.
processes.rawExpression:
(categorical_fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (masks_2: artifact spatial)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_3 extract]
-> (fragment_contours_1: artifact spatial)* + (categorical_fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [human specify]
-> (assembly_settings_1: instruction record) + (fragment_contours_1: artifact spatial)* + (categorical_fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_3 translate]
-> (numerical_fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (assembly_settings_1: instruction record) + (fragment_contours_1: artifact spatial)* + (categorical_fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (glyphs_1: artifact visual)* + (assembly_settings_1: instruction record) + (fragment_contours_1: artifact spatial)* + (categorical_fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [human modify]
-> (assembly_settings_1: instruction record) + (fragment_contours_1: artifact spatial)* + (categorical_fragments_1: artifact visual)* + (attribute_mappings_1: label record)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)

processes.name: Arrange and style the visualization
processes.description: Once the glyphs are assembled, the user chooses a visual style and optionally selects up to two data attributes to emphasize. A rule-based system recommends a placement format based on the selected attributes and their types, after which the user can adjust the layout, spacing, and display settings repeatedly until satisfied.
processes.rawExpression:
(glyphs_1: artifact visual)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [human specify]
-> (placement_settings_1: instruction record) + (glyphs_1: artifact visual)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_4 match]
-> (layout_recommendation_1: artifact record) + (placement_settings_1: instruction record) + (glyphs_1: artifact visual)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [human select]
-> (layout_1: instruction record) + (placement_settings_1: instruction record) + (glyphs_1: artifact visual)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (fgv_1: artifact visual) + (layout_1: instruction record) + (placement_settings_1: instruction record) + (glyphs_1: artifact visual)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)
-> [human modify]
-> (layout_1: instruction record) + (placement_settings_1: instruction record) + (glyphs_1: artifact visual)* + (dataset_1: artifact tabular)

processes.name: Export final visualization
processes.description: After accepting the arrangement, the user requests export of the completed figurative glyph-based visualization. The system renders the final design as a PNG image.
processes.rawExpression:
(fgv_1: artifact visual)
-> [human specify]
-> (fgv_1: artifact visual) + (export_request_1: instruction categorical)
-> [tool_3 translate]
-> (fgv_png_1: artifact visual)

representations.dataset: the CSV table the user uploads
representations.attributes: the table's columns, typed as categorical or numerical
representations.dataset_description: a text description of the attributes for the language model
representations.keyword_response: the language model's reply with related keywords
representations.keywords: suggested concept keywords for figurative images
representations.word_cloud: the keywords shown as a word cloud
representations.image_prompts: prompts for generating images of each keyword
representations.candidate_images: generated candidate images, three per concept
representations.concept_prompt: a keyword or custom description the user enters
representations.image_prompt: the prompt built from the user's concept
representations.glyph_image: the image the user picks as the glyph prototype
representations.regions: boxes the user draws around parts of the image to use for encoding
representations.attribute_mappings: which data attribute each part encodes
representations.fragments: the image parts cut out by their masks
representations.fragment_descriptions: text descriptions of what each part shows
representations.encoding_prompts: prompts for color and texture variants of each part
representations.categorical_fragments: part variants, one per category value
representations.fragment_contours: outlines of the parts used for placing copies
representations.assembly_settings: how numbers change parts (size scaling or duplication), spacing and layer order
representations.numerical_fragments: parts scaled or duplicated by numerical values
representations.glyphs: one assembled glyph per data row
representations.placement_settings: the chosen style and up to two attributes to emphasize
representations.layout: the arrangement of glyphs on the canvas
representations.fgv_png: the visualization as a PNG image
